pyqgis_plugin.name: Area Length Buttons
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds Area, Length, X and Y buttons to the attribute table toolbar. Click to add a virtual field with a chosen unit (m2/km2 or m/km) and decimal precision. Buttons auto enable/disable based on layer geometry type.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds four buttons to every attribute table toolbar. Area (polygon layers) adds a virtual area field in m2 or km2. Length (line layers) adds a virtual length field in m or km. X and Y (point layers) add virtual coordinate fields in the layer CRS. Decimal places configurable (default 3). Uses ellipsoidal measurement for area/length so geographic (lat/lon) layers also produce correct metric values.
